# pr-1580: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard

## Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1580
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1580
- **Title**: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1575` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 11
- **Additions**: +658
- **Deletions**: -146
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T09:57:19Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T17:30:43Z

## PR Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

`Get-Clipboard` runs under `powershell` (Windows PowerShell 5.1), whose redirected stdout is written in the OEM code page (e.g. cp437/cp850), **not** UTF-8.     '-NoProfile',
    '-Command',
    '[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard',
  ]),
);
```

- `xclip -selection clipboard -o` defaults to `STRING`; on a clipboard that holds only image flavors it errors out (fine).
- `wl-paste --no-newline` **without `--type` pastes the first MIME type offered by the source** — for an image-only clipboard that is `image/png`/`image/jpeg`, exit code 0, stdout = raw image bytes.

Trigger path: clipboard holds only a non-PNG image (e.g. JPEG-only — the image reader only probes `image/png`), so `readPasteboardImage` misses → the Ctrl+V fallback runs → `wl-paste --no-newline` happily returns the image bytes → `_textFromStdout` decodes them with `allowMalformed: true` → a wall of mojibake `PasteboardText` is inserted into the composer (and one keypress away from being submitted).

**Suggested fix** — pin text types the way the image path does:

```dart
for (final (executable, args) in [
  ('xclip', ['-selection', 'clipboard', '-t', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '-o']),
  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),
]) {

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1580
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1580
- **Title**: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1575` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 11
- **Additions**: +658
- **Deletions**: -146
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T09:57:19Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T17:30:43Z

## PR Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Windows text read is not UTF-8 — non-ASCII clipboard text mojibakes**

`Get-Clipboard` runs under `powershell` (Windows PowerShell 5.1), whose redirected stdout is written in the OEM code page (e.g. cp437/cp850), **not** UTF-8. The output is then decoded as UTF-8 here with `allowMalformed: true`, so any non-ASCII clipboard text ("café", "Привет", CJK) silently degrades to U+FFFD replacement characters — exactly the lossy path this repo's image readers deliberately avoid: the pre-existing `_readWindows` image path never reads stdout (it writes a file and reads the bytes back, see `_readWindows` below in this file).

Secondary: `Get-Clipboard` formats each line with `\r\n`, so multi-line text keeps embedded `\r` after the single trailing-newline strip; the composer inserts verbatim (no `\r` normalization exists in the TUI paste path).

**Suggested fix** (mirror the image path's stdout avoidance, or pin the encoding):

```dart
final read = _textFromStdout(
  await runner('powershell', [
    '-NoProfile',
    '-Command',
    '[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard',
  ]),
);
```

- `xclip -selection clipboard -o` defaults to `STRING`; on a clipboard that holds only image flavors it errors out (fine).
- `wl-paste --no-newline` **without `--type` pastes the first MIME type offered by the source** — for an image-only clipboard that is `image/png`/`image/jpeg`, exit code 0, stdout = raw image bytes.

Trigger path: clipboard holds only a non-PNG image (e.g. JPEG-only — the image reader only probes `image/png`), so `readPasteboardImage` misses → the Ctrl+V fallback runs → `wl-paste --no-newline` happily returns the image bytes → `_textFromStdout` decodes them with `allowMalformed: true` → a wall of mojibake `PasteboardText` is inserted into the composer (and one keypress away from being submitted).

**Suggested fix** — pin text types the way the image path does:

```dart
for (final (executable, args) in [
  ('xclip', ['-selection', 'clipboard', '-t', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '-o']),
  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),
]) {
```

# pr-1580: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard

## Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1575` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 11
- **Additions**: +658
- **Deletions**: -146
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T09:57:19Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T17:30:43Z

## PR Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

# pr-1580: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard

## Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

project: (note) flutter_agent_harness rework gotcha (gh-1403 round, 2026-10-08): the WIP auto-save bot formats staged Dart files with a PRE-tall-style formatter before committing — its commit fbf142951 reformatted ~1853 unrelated lines of test/release_hygiene_test.dart from the repo's canonical tall style (Dart 3.13 `dart format`, which CI's setup-dart stable produces and which main's files satisfy) into short style, silently bloating the PR diff even though CI itself does NOT gate on format (no `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` in ci.yml; only scripts/pre-commit self-heals, and only for agents that run it). Recovery recipe that worked: when a rework wants a test concern OUT of a god-file, checkout the file from origin/main (if the net intent is "file returns byte-identical to main") instead of incrementally un-deleting, rewrite any new sibling file with tall-style content, settle with `dart format`, and let the bot commit+push — never force-push over the automation. Verify the final `git diff origin/main --stat` is feature-shaped only. Also: the bot can race you between `git add` and `git commit` ("nothing to commit" = check `git log` — your tree is already committed/pushed; content identical means done). [#note,#source_agent,workflow,git,auto-save-bot,formatter,gotcha,gh-1403]
project: (note) PR branches in IstiN/flutter_agent_harness are swept by an auto-save bot: a dirty working tree gets committed AND pushed as "pr-<n> WIP auto-save <timestamp>" within minutes (precedent: pr-1295 round 5, commit dea5eb42d captured the rework's staged work mid-task). Do not leave half-finished edits in the tree; if the bot captures your changes, do NOT force-push to rewrite — the repo's own merged PRs carry WIP auto-save commits in their history (#1268). Check `git log` before staging: your "uncommitted" work may already be committed. [#note,#source_agent,workflow,git,auto-save-bot,pr-branches]

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1580
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1580
- **Title**: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1575` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 11
- **Additions**: +658
- **Deletions**: -146
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T09:57:19Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T17:30:43Z

## PR Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

# pr-1580: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard

## Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1580
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1580
- **Title**: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1575` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 11
- **Additions**: +658
- **Deletions**: -146
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T09:57:19Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T17:30:43Z

## PR Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Windows text read is not UTF-8 — non-ASCII clipboard text mojibakes**

`Get-Clipboard` runs under `powershell` (Windows PowerShell 5.1), whose redirected stdout is written in the OEM code page (e.g. cp437/cp850), **not** UTF-8. The output is then decoded as UTF-8 here with `allowMalformed: true`, so any non-ASCII clipboard text ("café", "Привет", CJK) silently degrades to U+FFFD replacement characters — exactly the lossy path this repo's image readers deliberately avoid: the pre-existing `_readWindows` image path never reads stdout (it writes a file and reads the bytes back, see `_readWindows` below in this file).

Secondary: `Get-Clipboard` formats each line with `\r\n`, so multi-line text keeps embedded `\r` after the single trailing-newline strip; the composer inserts verbatim (no `\r` normalization exists in the TUI paste path).

**Suggested fix** (mirror the image path's stdout avoidance, or pin the encoding):

```dart
final read = _textFromStdout(
  await runner('powershell', [
    '-NoProfile',
    '-Command',
    '[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard',
  ]),
);
```

and normalize embedded `\r\n` → `\n` alongside the trailing strip. Untestable on the Linux CI runner, so at minimum worth a follow-up card — but as written, the Windows Ctrl+V text fallback corrupts everything outside ASCII.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Linux text backends are not type-pinned — an image-only clipboard can be dumped into the composer as garbage "text"**

The image path pins explicit content types (`xclip … -t image/png`, `wl-paste --type image/png`), but the new text loop does not:

- `xclip -selection clipboard -o` defaults to `STRING`; on a clipboard that holds only image flavors it errors out (fine).
- `wl-paste --no-newline` **without `--type` pastes the first MIME type offered by the source** — for an image-only clipboard that is `image/png`/`image/jpeg`, exit code 0, stdout = raw image bytes.

Trigger path: clipboard holds only a non-PNG image (e.g. JPEG-only — the image reader only probes `image/png`), so `readPasteboardImage` misses → the Ctrl+V fallback runs → `wl-paste --no-newline` happily returns the image bytes → `_textFromStdout` decodes them with `allowMalformed: true` → a wall of mojibake `PasteboardText` is inserted into the composer (and one keypress away from being submitted).

**Suggested fix** — pin text types the way the image path does:

```dart
for (final (executable, args) in [
  ('xclip', ['-selection', 'clipboard', '-t', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '-o']),
  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),
]) {
```

With explicit types, an image-only clipboard fails both backends and keeps the correct named `'xclip/wl-paste unavailable or clipboard holds no text'` reason instead of pasting binary garbage.

);

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1580
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1580
- **Title**: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1575` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 11
- **Additions**: +658
- **Deletions**: -146
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T09:57:19Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T17:30:43Z

## PR Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Windows text read is not UTF-8 — non-ASCII clipboard text mojibakes**

`Get-Clipboard` runs under `powershell` (Windows PowerShell 5.1), whose redirected stdout is written in the OEM code page (e.g. cp437/cp850), **not** UTF-8. The output is then decoded as UTF-8 here with `allowMalformed: true`, so any non-ASCII clipboard text ("café", "Привет", CJK) silently degrades to U+FFFD replacement characters — exactly the lossy path this repo's image readers deliberately avoid: the pre-existing `_readWindows` image path never reads stdout (it writes a file and reads the bytes back, see `_readWindows` below in this file).

Secondary: `Get-Clipboard` formats each line with `\r\n`, so multi-line text keeps embedded `\r` after the single trailing-newline strip; the composer inserts verbatim (no `\r` normalization exists in the TUI paste path).

**Suggested fix** (mirror the image path's stdout avoidance, or pin the encoding):

```dart
final read = _textFromStdout(
  await runner('powershell', [
    '-NoProfile',
    '-Command',
    '[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard',
  ]),
);
```

- `xclip -selection clipboard -o` defaults to `STRING`; on a clipboard that holds only image flavors it errors out (fine).
- `wl-paste --no-newline` **without `--type` pastes the first MIME type offered by the source** — for an image-only clipboard that is `image/png`/`image/jpeg`, exit code 0, stdout = raw image bytes.

Trigger path: clipboard holds only a non-PNG image (e.g. JPEG-only — the image reader only probes `image/png`), so `readPasteboardImage` misses → the Ctrl+V fallback runs → `wl-paste --no-newline` happily returns the image bytes → `_textFromStdout` decodes them with `allowMalformed: true` → a wall of mojibake `PasteboardText` is inserted into the composer (and one keypress away from being submitted).

**Suggested fix** — pin text types the way the image path does:

```dart
for (final (executable, args) in [
  ('xclip', ['-selection', 'clipboard', '-t', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '-o']),
  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),
]) {
```

# pr-1580: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard

## Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1580

- **Title**: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1575` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 11
- **Additions**: +658
- **Deletions**: -146
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T09:57:19Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T17:30:43Z

## PR Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

`Get-Clipboard` runs under `powershell` (Windows PowerShell 5.1), whose redirected stdout is written in the OEM code page (e.g. cp437/cp850), **not** UTF-8. The output is then decoded as UTF-8 here with `allowMalformed: true`, so any non-ASCII clipboard text ("café", "Привет", CJK) silently degrades to U+FFFD replacement characters — exactly the lossy path this repo's image readers deliberately avoid: the pre-existing `_readWindows` image path never reads stdout (it writes a file and reads the bytes back, see `_readWindows` below in this file).

    '-NoProfile',
    '-Command',
    '[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard',

);

**Suggested fix** — pin text types the way the image path does:

```dart
for (final (executable, args) in [

  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),

# pr-1580: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard

## Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get

      # Issue #1234: the ≤2800-line file guard MOVED into crap4dart's loc
      # gate (crap4dart.yaml, wc -l parity verified by the maintainer
      # recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1580

- **Title**: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1575` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 11
- **Additions**: +658
- **Deletions**: -146
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T09:57:19Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T17:30:43Z

## PR Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Windows text read is not UTF-8 — non-ASCII clipboard text mojibakes**

`Get-Clipboard` runs under `powershell` (Windows PowerShell 5.1), whose redirected stdout is written in the OEM code page (e.g. cp437/cp850), **not** UTF-8. The output is then decoded as UTF-8 here with `allowMalformed: true`, so any non-ASCII clipboard text ("café", "Привет", CJK) silently degrades to U+FFFD replacement characters — exactly the lossy path this repo's image readers deliberately avoid: the pre-existing `_readWindows` image path never reads stdout (it writes a file and reads the bytes back, see `_readWindows` below in this file).

Secondary: `Get-Clipboard` formats each line with `\r\n`, so multi-line text keeps embedded `\r` after the single trailing-newline strip; the composer inserts verbatim (no `\r` normalization exists in the TUI paste path).

**Suggested fix** (mirror the image path's stdout avoidance, or pin the encoding):

```dart
final read = _textFromStdout(
  await runner('powershell', [
    '-NoProfile',
    '-Command',
    '[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard',
  ]),
);
```

and normalize embedded `\r\n` → `\n` alongside the trailing strip. Untestable on the Linux CI runner, so at minimum worth a follow-up card — but as written, the Windows Ctrl+V text fallback corrupts everything outside ASCII.

---

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Linux text backends are not type-pinned — an image-only clipboard can be dumped into the composer as garbage "text"**

The image path pins explicit content types (`xclip … -t image/png`, `wl-paste --type image/png`), but the new text loop does not:

- `xclip -selection clipboard -o` defaults to `STRING`; on a clipboard that holds only image flavors it errors out (fine).
- `wl-paste --no-newline` **without `--type` pastes the first MIME type offered by the source** — for an image-only clipboard that is `image/png`/`image/jpeg`, exit code 0, stdout = raw image bytes.

Trigger path: clipboard holds only a non-PNG image (e.g. JPEG-only — the image reader only probes `image/png`), so `readPasteboardImage` misses → the Ctrl+V fallback runs → `wl-paste --no-newline` happily returns the image bytes → `_textFromStdout` decodes them with `allowMalformed: true` → a wall of mojibake `PasteboardText` is inserted into the composer (and one keypress away from being submitted).

**Suggested fix** — pin text types the way the image path does:

```dart
for (final (executable, args) in [
  ('xclip', ['-selection', 'clipboard', '-t', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '-o']),
  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),
]) {
```

With explicit types, an image-only clipboard fails both backends and keeps the correct named `'xclip/wl-paste unavailable or clipboard holds no text'` reason instead of pasting binary garbage.

uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get

      # Issue #1234: the ≤2800-line file guard MOVED into crap4dart's loc
      # gate (crap4dart.yaml, wc -l parity verified by the maintainer
      # recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1580
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1580
- **Title**: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1575` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 11
- **Additions**: +658
- **Deletions**: -146
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T09:57:19Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T17:30:43Z

## PR Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

# pr-1580: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard

## Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

      # Issue #1234: the ≤2800-line file guard MOVED into crap4dart's loc

      # recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"

      - name: Merge shard coverage (union DA hits per file, NOT cat)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          mkdir -p coverage
          python3 scripts/merge_lcov.py -o coverage/lcov.info coverage-shards/*/lcov.info

      - name: CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          # Issue #447: 0.9.5+ carries the gate framework (broken_goldens
          # et al.); 0.2.1 knew only the CRAP ratchet. Both configs set
          # coverage.run_tests: false — the merged shard lcov above is the
          # coverage source; gates must not re-run the suite.
          # gh-1061: >=0.10.0 — analyzer 7.3→14.4 refresh + the
          # duplication.sources key (native cross-module scan).
          # gh-1106: >=0.11.0 — Type-2 renamed-clone detection
          # (duplication.ignore_locals) + gate baselines; the
          # duplication gate config throws on older parsers (unknown
          # keys are a ConfigException).
          # Bounded (rework review): a floating >= would auto-adopt
          # 0.12.0+ with no repo change — bump the ceiling deliberately.
          dart pub global activate crap4dart ">=0.11.0 <0.12.0"
          dart pub global run crap4dart analyze

      - name: Quality gates (broken goldens + Type-2 duplication, issue 1106)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --baseline

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1575` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 11
- **Additions**: +658
- **Deletions**: -146
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T09:57:19Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T17:30:43Z

## PR Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

**Suggested fix** (mirror the image path's stdout avoidance, or pin the encoding):

```dart

  await runner('powershell', [
    '-NoProfile',
    '-Command',
    '[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard',
  ]),
);
```

and normalize embedded `\r\n` → `\n` alongside the trailing strip. Untestable on the Linux CI runner, so at minimum worth a follow-up card — but as written, the Windows Ctrl+V text fallback corrupts everything outside ASCII.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Linux text backends are not type-pinned — an image-only clipboard can be dumped into the composer as garbage "text"**

The image path pins explicit content types (`xclip … -t image/png`, `wl-paste --type image/png`), but the new text loop does not:

- `xclip -selection clipboard -o` defaults to `STRING`; on a clipboard that holds only image flavors it errors out (fine).
- `wl-paste --no-newline` **without `--type` pastes the first MIME type offered by the source** — for an image-only clipboard that is `image/png`/`image/jpeg`, exit code 0, stdout = raw image bytes.

Trigger path: clipboard holds only a non-PNG image (e.g. JPEG-only — the image reader only probes `image/png`), so `readPasteboardImage` misses → the Ctrl+V fallback runs → `wl-paste --no-newline` happily returns the image bytes → `_textFromStdout` decodes them with `allowMalformed: true` → a wall of mojibake `PasteboardText` is inserted into the composer (and one keypress away from being submitted).

**Suggested fix** — pin text types the way the image path does:

```dart
for (final (executable, args) in [
  ('xclip', ['-selection', 'clipboard', '-t', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '-o']),
  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),
]) {
```

With explicit types, an image-only clipboard fails both backends and keeps the correct named `'xclip/wl-paste unavailable or clipboard holds no text'` reason instead of pasting binary garbage.

# pr-1580: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard

## Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Merge shard coverage (union DA hits per file, NOT cat)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          mkdir -p coverage
          python3 scripts/merge_lcov.py -o coverage/lcov.info coverage-shards/*/lcov.info

      - name: CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          # Issue #447: 0.9.5+ carries the gate framework (broken_goldens
          # et al.); 0.2.1 knew only the CRAP ratchet. Both configs set
          # coverage.run_tests: false — the merged shard lcov above is the
          # coverage source; gates must not re-run the suite.
          # gh-1061: >=0.10.0 — analyzer 7.3→14.4 refresh + the
          # duplication.sources key (native cross-module scan).
          # gh-1106: >=0.11.0 — Type-2 renamed-clone detection
          # (duplication.ignore_locals) + gate baselines; the
          # duplication gate config throws on older parsers (unknown
          # keys are a ConfigException).
          # Bounded (rework review): a floating >= would auto-adopt
          # 0.12.0+ with no repo change — bump the ceiling deliberately.
          dart pub global activate crap4dart ">=0.11.0 <0.12.0"
          dart pub global run crap4dart analyze

      - name: Quality gates (broken goldens + Type-2 duplication, issue 1106)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --baseline

      # Issue #1234 rework: 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override (a
      # gates.loc.sources key is a ConfigException — caught here on
      # 019ede65), and the package config's sources drive the CRAP census
      # too, so test/ + example/ get the SAME loc gate from the companion
      # config (crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml) — the scope the retired shell
      # guards (gh-1232) scanned there. No baseline: nothing exceeds 2800
      # today, and the ceiling itself is the point.
      - name: Loc scope gate (test/ + example/, gh-1232 whole-tree ceiling)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --config crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml --only loc

      - name: Duplication guard (lib/ < 1%)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          npx --yes jscpd@5 --min-tokens 50 --min-lines 5 --reporters json \
            --output /tmp/jscpd-ci lib/ || true

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1580
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1580
- **Title**: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1575` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 11
- **Additions**: +658
- **Deletions**: -146
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T09:57:19Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T17:30:43Z

## PR Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Windows text read is not UTF-8 — non-ASCII clipboard text mojibakes**

`Get-Clipboard` runs under `powershell` (Windows PowerShell 5.1), whose redirected stdout is written in the OEM code page (e.g. cp437/cp850), **not** UTF-8. The output is then decoded as UTF-8 here with `allowMalformed: true`, so any non-ASCII clipboard text ("café", "Привет", CJK) silently degrades to U+FFFD replacement characters — exactly the lossy path this repo's image readers deliberately avoid: the pre-existing `_readWindows` image path never reads stdout (it writes a file and reads the bytes back, see `_readWindows` below in this file).

Secondary: `Get-Clipboard` formats each line with `\r\n`, so multi-line text keeps embedded `\r` after the single trailing-newline strip; the composer inserts verbatim (no `\r` normalization exists in the TUI paste path).

**Suggested fix** (mirror the image path's stdout avoidance, or pin the encoding):

```dart
final read = _textFromStdout(
  await runner('powershell', [
    '-NoProfile',
    '-Command',
    '[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard',
  ]),
);
```

and normalize embedded `\r\n` → `\n` alongside the trailing strip. Untestable on the Linux CI runner, so at minimum worth a follow-up card — but as written, the Windows Ctrl+V text fallback corrupts everything outside ASCII.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Linux text backends are not type-pinned — an image-only clipboard can be dumped into the composer as garbage "text"**

The image path pins explicit content types (`xclip … -t image/png`, `wl-paste --type image/png`), but the new text loop does not:

- `xclip -selection clipboard -o` defaults to `STRING`; on a clipboard that holds only image flavors it errors out (fine).
- `wl-paste --no-newline` **without `--type` pastes the first MIME type offered by the source** — for an image-only clipboard that is `image/png`/`image/jpeg`, exit code 0, stdout = raw image bytes.

Trigger path: clipboard holds only a non-PNG image (e.g. JPEG-only — the image reader only probes `image/png`), so `readPasteboardImage` misses → the Ctrl+V fallback runs → `wl-paste --no-newline` happily returns the image bytes → `_textFromStdout` decodes them with `allowMalformed: true` → a wall of mojibake `PasteboardText` is inserted into the composer (and one keypress away from being submitted).

**Suggested fix** — pin text types the way the image path does:

```dart
for (final (executable, args) in [
  ('xclip', ['-selection', 'clipboard', '-t', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '-o']),
  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),
]) {
```

With explicit types, an image-only clipboard fails both backends and keeps the correct named `'xclip/wl-paste unavailable or clipboard holds no text'` reason instead of pasting binary garbage.

# pr-1580: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard

## Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done

          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1580
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1580
- **Title**: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1575` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 11
- **Additions**: +658
- **Deletions**: -146
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T09:57:19Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T17:30:43Z

## PR Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Windows text read is not UTF-8 — non-ASCII clipboard text mojibakes**

`Get-Clipboard` runs under `powershell` (Windows PowerShell 5.1), whose redirected stdout is written in the OEM code page (e.g. cp437/cp850), **not** UTF-8. The output is then decoded as UTF-8 here with `allowMalformed: true`, so any non-ASCII clipboard text ("café", "Привет", CJK) silently degrades to U+FFFD replacement characters — exactly the lossy path this repo's image readers deliberately avoid: the pre-existing `_readWindows` image path never reads stdout (it writes a file and reads the bytes back, see `_readWindows` below in this file).

Secondary: `Get-Clipboard` formats each line with `\r\n`, so multi-line text keeps embedded `\r` after the single trailing-newline strip; the composer inserts verbatim (no `\r` normalization exists in the TUI paste path).

**Suggested fix** (mirror the image path's stdout avoidance, or pin the encoding):

```dart
final read = _textFromStdout(
  await runner('powershell', [
    '-NoProfile',
    '-Command',
    '[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard',
  ]),
);
```

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Linux text backends are not type-pinned — an image-only clipboard can be dumped into the composer as garbage "text"**

- `xclip -selection clipboard -o` defaults to `STRING`; on a clipboard that holds only image flavors it errors out (fine).
- `wl-paste --no-newline` **without `--type` pastes the first MIME type offered by the source** — for an image-only clipboard that is `image/png`/`image/jpeg`, exit code 0, stdout = raw image bytes.

Trigger path: clipboard holds only a non-PNG image (e.g. JPEG-only — the image reader only probes `image/png`), so `readPasteboardImage` misses → the Ctrl+V fallback runs → `wl-paste --no-newline` happily returns the image bytes → `_textFromStdout` decodes them with `allowMalformed: true` → a wall of mojibake `PasteboardText` is inserted into the composer (and one keypress away from being submitted).

**Suggested fix** — pin text types the way the image path does:

```dart
for (final (executable, args) in [
  ('xclip', ['-selection', 'clipboard', '-t', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '-o']),
  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),
]) {
```

With explicit types, an image-only clipboard fails both backends and keeps the correct named `'xclip/wl-paste unavailable or clipboard holds no text'` reason instead of pasting binary garbage.

# pr-1580: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard

## Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
