# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1580
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1580
- **Title**: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1575` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 11
- **Additions**: +658
- **Deletions**: -146
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T09:57:19Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T17:30:43Z

## PR Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

# pr-1580: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard

## Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

      # Issue #1234: the ≤2800-line file guard MOVED into crap4dart's loc
      # gate (crap4dart.yaml, wc -l parity verified by the maintainer
      # recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1580

- **Title**: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1575` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 11
- **Additions**: +658
- **Deletions**: -146
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T09:57:19Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T17:30:43Z

## PR Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Windows text read is not UTF-8 — non-ASCII clipboard text mojibakes**

`Get-Clipboard` runs under `powershell` (Windows PowerShell 5.1), whose redirected stdout is written in the OEM code page (e.g. cp437/cp850), **not** UTF-8. The output is then decoded as UTF-8 here with `allowMalformed: true`, so any non-ASCII clipboard text ("café", "Привет", CJK) silently degrades to U+FFFD replacement characters — exactly the lossy path this repo's image readers deliberately avoid: the pre-existing `_readWindows` image path never reads stdout (it writes a file and reads the bytes back, see `_readWindows` below in this file).

Secondary: `Get-Clipboard` formats each line with `\r\n`, so multi-line text keeps embedded `\r` after the single trailing-newline strip; the composer inserts verbatim (no `\r` normalization exists in the TUI paste path).

**Suggested fix** (mirror the image path's stdout avoidance, or pin the encoding):

```dart
final read = _textFromStdout(
  await runner('powershell', [
    '-NoProfile',
    '-Command',
    '[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard',
  ]),
);
```

and normalize embedded `\r\n` → `\n` alongside the trailing strip. Untestable on the Linux CI runner, so at minimum worth a follow-up card — but as written, the Windows Ctrl+V text fallback corrupts everything outside ASCII.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Linux text backends are not type-pinned — an image-only clipboard can be dumped into the composer as garbage "text"**

The image path pins explicit content types (`xclip … -t image/png`, `wl-paste --type image/png`), but the new text loop does not:

- `xclip -selection clipboard -o` defaults to `STRING`; on a clipboard that holds only image flavors it errors out (fine).
- `wl-paste --no-newline` **without `--type` pastes the first MIME type offered by the source** — for an image-only clipboard that is `image/png`/`image/jpeg`, exit code 0, stdout = raw image bytes.

Trigger path: clipboard holds only a non-PNG image (e.g. JPEG-only — the image reader only probes `image/png`), so `readPasteboardImage` misses → the Ctrl+V fallback runs → `wl-paste --no-newline` happily returns the image bytes → `_textFromStdout` decodes them with `allowMalformed: true` → a wall of mojibake `PasteboardText` is inserted into the composer (and one keypress away from being submitted).

**Suggested fix** — pin text types the way the image path does:

```dart
for (final (executable, args) in [
  ('xclip', ['-selection', 'clipboard', '-t', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '-o']),
  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),
]) {
```

With explicit types, an image-only clipboard fails both backends and keeps the correct named `'xclip/wl-paste unavailable or clipboard holds no text'` reason instead of pasting binary garbage.

        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}

      # Issue #1234: the ≤2800-line file guard MOVED into crap4dart's loc
      # gate (crap4dart.yaml, wc -l parity verified by the maintainer
      # recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"

      - name: Merge shard coverage (union DA hits per file, NOT cat)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          mkdir -p coverage
          python3 scripts/merge_lcov.py -o coverage/lcov.info coverage-shards/*/lcov.info

      - name: CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          # Issue #447: 0.9.5+ carries the gate framework (broken_goldens
          # et al.); 0.2.1 knew only the CRAP ratchet. Both configs set
          # coverage.run_tests: false — the merged shard lcov above is the
          # coverage source; gates must not re-run the suite.
          # gh-1061: >=0.10.0 — analyzer 7.3→14.4 refresh + the
          # duplication.sources key (native cross-module scan).
          # gh-1106: >=0.11.0 — Type-2 renamed-clone detection
          # (duplication.ignore_locals) + gate baselines; the
          # duplication gate config throws on older parsers (unknown
          # keys are a ConfigException).
          # Bounded (rework review): a floating >= would auto-adopt
          # 0.12.0+ with no repo change — bump the ceiling deliberately.
          dart pub global activate crap4dart ">=0.11.0 <0.12.0"
          dart pub global run crap4dart analyze

      - name: Quality gates (broken goldens + Type-2 duplication, issue 1106)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --baseline

      # Issue #1234 rework: 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override (a
      # gates.loc.sources key is a ConfigException — caught here on
      # 019ede65), and the package config's sources drive the CRAP census
      # too, so test/ + example/ get the SAME loc gate from the companion
      # config (crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml) — the scope the retired shell
      # guards (gh-1232) scanned there. No baseline: nothing exceeds 2800

      - name: Loc scope gate (test/ + example/, gh-1232 whole-tree ceiling)

          npx --yes jscpd@5 --min-tokens 50 --min-lines 5 --reporters json \

- **Author**: ai-teammate

- **State**: open

- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T17:30:43Z

## PR Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Windows text read is not UTF-8 — non-ASCII clipboard text mojibakes**

`Get-Clipboard` runs under `powershell` (Windows PowerShell 5.1), whose redirected stdout is written in the OEM code page (e.g. cp437/cp850), **not** UTF-8. The output is then decoded as UTF-8 here with `allowMalformed: true`, so any non-ASCII clipboard text ("café", "Привет", CJK) silently degrades to U+FFFD replacement characters — exactly the lossy path this repo's image readers deliberately avoid: the pre-existing `_readWindows` image path never reads stdout (it writes a file and reads the bytes back, see `_readWindows` below in this file).

Secondary: `Get-Clipboard` formats each line with `\r\n`, so multi-line text keeps embedded `\r` after the single trailing-newline strip; the composer inserts verbatim (no `\r` normalization exists in the TUI paste path).

**Suggested fix** (mirror the image path's stdout avoidance, or pin the encoding):

```dart
final read = _textFromStdout(
  await runner('powershell', [
    '-NoProfile',
    '-Command',
    '[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard',
  ]),
);
```

and normalize embedded `\r\n` → `\n` alongside the trailing strip. Untestable on the Linux CI runner, so at minimum worth a follow-up card — but as written, the Windows Ctrl+V text fallback corrupts everything outside ASCII.

---

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Linux text backends are not type-pinned — an image-only clipboard can be dumped into the composer as garbage "text"**

The image path pins explicit content types (`xclip … -t image/png`, `wl-paste --type image/png`), but the new text loop does not:

- `xclip -selection clipboard -o` defaults to `STRING`; on a clipboard that holds only image flavors it errors out (fine).
- `wl-paste --no-newline` **without `--type` pastes the first MIME type offered by the source** — for an image-only clipboard that is `image/png`/`image/jpeg`, exit code 0, stdout = raw image bytes.

Trigger path: clipboard holds only a non-PNG image (e.g. JPEG-only — the image reader only probes `image/png`), so `readPasteboardImage` misses → the Ctrl+V fallback runs → `wl-paste --no-newline` happily returns the image bytes → `_textFromStdout` decodes them with `allowMalformed: true` → a wall of mojibake `PasteboardText` is inserted into the composer (and one keypress away from being submitted).

**Suggested fix** — pin text types the way the image path does:

```dart
for (final (executable, args) in [
  ('xclip', ['-selection', 'clipboard', '-t', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '-o']),
  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),
]) {
```

With explicit types, an image-only clipboard fails both backends and keeps the correct named `'xclip/wl-paste unavailable or clipboard holds no text'` reason instead of pasting binary garbage.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"

## PR Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

);

**Suggested fix** — pin text types the way the image path does:

```dart
for (final (executable, args) in [

  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),

uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get

      # Issue #1234: the ≤2800-line file guard MOVED into crap4dart's loc
      # gate (crap4dart.yaml, wc -l parity verified by the maintainer
      # recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"

path: coverage-shards

      - name: Merge shard coverage (union DA hits per file, NOT cat)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          mkdir -p coverage
          python3 scripts/merge_lcov.py -o coverage/lcov.info coverage-shards/*/lcov.info

      - name: CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          # Issue #447: 0.9.5+ carries the gate framework (broken_goldens
          # et al.); 0.2.1 knew only the CRAP ratchet. Both configs set
          # coverage.run_tests: false — the merged shard lcov above is the
          # coverage source; gates must not re-run the suite.
          # gh-1061: >=0.10.0 — analyzer 7.3→14.4 refresh + the
          # duplication.sources key (native cross-module scan).
          # gh-1106: >=0.11.0 — Type-2 renamed-clone detection
          # (duplication.ignore_locals) + gate baselines; the
          # duplication gate config throws on older parsers (unknown
          # keys are a ConfigException).
          # Bounded (rework review): a floating >= would auto-adopt
          # 0.12.0+ with no repo change — bump the ceiling deliberately.
          dart pub global activate crap4dart ">=0.11.0 <0.12.0"
          dart pub global run crap4dart analyze

      - name: Quality gates (broken goldens + Type-2 duplication, issue 1106)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --baseline

      # Issue #1234 rework: 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override (a
      # gates.loc.sources key is a ConfigException — caught here on
      # 019ede65), and the package config's sources drive the CRAP census
      # too, so test/ + example/ get the SAME loc gate from the companion
      # config (crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml) — the scope the retired shell
      # guards (gh-1232) scanned there. No baseline: nothing exceeds 2800
      # today, and the ceiling itself is the point.
      - name: Loc scope gate (test/ + example/, gh-1232 whole-tree ceiling)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          npx --yes jscpd@5 --min-tokens 50 --min-lines 5 --reporters json \

## PR Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Windows text read is not UTF-8 — non-ASCII clipboard text mojibakes**

`Get-Clipboard` runs under `powershell` (Windows PowerShell 5.1), whose redirected stdout is written in the OEM code page (e.g. cp437/cp850), **not** UTF-8. **Suggested fix** (mirror the image path's stdout avoidance, or pin the encoding):

```dart

  await runner('powershell', [
    '-NoProfile',
    '-Command',
    '[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard',
  ]),
);
```

and normalize embedded `\r\n` → `\n` alongside the trailing strip. Untestable on the Linux CI runner, so at minimum worth a follow-up card — but as written, the Windows Ctrl+V text fallback corrupts everything outside ASCII.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Linux text backends are not type-pinned — an image-only clipboard can be dumped into the composer as garbage "text"**

The image path pins explicit content types (`xclip … -t image/png`, `wl-paste --type image/png`), but the new text loop does not:

- `xclip -selection clipboard -o` defaults to `STRING`; on a clipboard that holds only image flavors it errors out (fine).
- `wl-paste --no-newline` **without `--type` pastes the first MIME type offered by the source** — for an image-only clipboard that is `image/png`/`image/jpeg`, exit code 0, stdout = raw image bytes.

Trigger path: clipboard holds only a non-PNG image (e.g. JPEG-only — the image reader only probes `image/png`), so `readPasteboardImage` misses → the Ctrl+V fallback runs → `wl-paste --no-newline` happily returns the image bytes → `_textFromStdout` decodes them with `allowMalformed: true` → a wall of mojibake `PasteboardText` is inserted into the composer (and one keypress away from being submitted).

**Suggested fix** — pin text types the way the image path does:

```dart
for (final (executable, args) in [
  ('xclip', ['-selection', 'clipboard', '-t', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '-o']),
  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),
]) {
```

With explicit types, an image-only clipboard fails both backends and keeps the correct named `'xclip/wl-paste unavailable or clipboard holds no text'` reason instead of pasting binary garbage.

      # Issue #1234: the ≤2800-line file guard MOVED into crap4dart's loc
      # gate (crap4dart.yaml, wc -l parity verified by the maintainer
      # recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"

          # gh-1061: >=0.10.0 — analyzer 7.3→14.4 refresh + the

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1580
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1580
- **Title**: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1575` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 11
- **Additions**: +658
- **Deletions**: -146
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T09:57:19Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T17:30:43Z

## PR Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

`fa_tui.dart` sat at exactly 2800 lines on `main` (zero headroom — issue #1234's ≤2800 wc-l gate, re-enshrined in `crap4dart.yaml` `gates.loc`). This PR adds 7 lines to that file (the `readClipboardText` ctor param + doc + field), pushing it to 2807. The `Quality gate` aggregate is red only because of this leg (`Quality gate FAILED: a leg is failure (guards)`). The CRAP ratchet itself passed and the duplication gate is a soft `[WARN]` — the loc gate is the single root cause.

This is the same reason `fa_tui_paste.dart` exists: its header says it was *"split out of `fa_tui.dart` to keep it under the repo's 2800-line size gate"*.

**Fix options:**
- Move `FaTuiCallbacks` (~120 lines, lines ~100-220) into a new part file (e.g. `fa_tui_callbacks.dart`, `part of 'fa_tui.dart'`) — part files are separate files, so `wc -l` on `fa_tui.dart` drops well under the cap and the zone-split precedent holds; **or**
- relocate ≥7 net lines of any self-contained member into an existing part file (`fa_tui_paste.dart` has headroom).

Note a doc-comment trim alone cannot fit: the ctor param + field are irreducible (2 lines) and the file is 7 over. The `max_lines` is "only down" — do not raise the threshold in `crap4dart.yaml`.

---

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Windows text read is not UTF-8 — non-ASCII clipboard text mojibakes**

`Get-Clipboard` runs under `powershell` (Windows PowerShell 5.1), whose redirected stdout is written in the OEM code page (e.g. cp437/cp850), **not** UTF-8. The output is then decoded as UTF-8 here with `allowMalformed: true`, so any non-ASCII clipboard text ("café", "Привет", CJK) silently degrades to U+FFFD replacement characters — exactly the lossy path this repo's image readers deliberately avoid: the pre-existing `_readWindows` image path never reads stdout (it writes a file and reads the bytes back, see `_readWindows` below in this file).

Secondary: `Get-Clipboard` formats each line with `\r\n`, so multi-line text keeps embedded `\r` after the single trailing-newline strip; the composer inserts verbatim (no `\r` normalization exists in the TUI paste path).

**Suggested fix** (mirror the image path's stdout avoidance, or pin the encoding):

```dart
final read = _textFromStdout(
  await runner('powershell', [
    '-NoProfile',
    '-Command',
    '[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard',
  ]),
);
```

and normalize embedded `\r\n` → `\n` alongside the trailing strip. Untestable on the Linux CI runner, so at minimum worth a follow-up card — but as written, the Windows Ctrl+V text fallback corrupts everything outside ASCII.

---

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Linux text backends are not type-pinned — an image-only clipboard can be dumped into the composer as garbage "text"**

The image path pins explicit content types (`xclip … -t image/png`, `wl-paste --type image/png`), but the new text loop does not:

- `xclip -selection clipboard -o` defaults to `STRING`; on a clipboard that holds only image flavors it errors out (fine).
- `wl-paste --no-newline` **without `--type` pastes the first MIME type offered by the source** — for an image-only clipboard that is `image/png`/`image/jpeg`, exit code 0, stdout = raw image bytes.

Trigger path: clipboard holds only a non-PNG image (e.g. JPEG-only — the image reader only probes `image/png`), so `readPasteboardImage` misses → the Ctrl+V fallback runs → `wl-paste --no-newline` happily returns the image bytes → `_textFromStdout` decodes them with `allowMalformed: true` → a wall of mojibake `PasteboardText` is inserted into the composer (and one keypress away from being submitted).

**Suggested fix** — pin text types the way the image path does:

```dart
for (final (executable, args) in [
  ('xclip', ['-selection', 'clipboard', '-t', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '-o']),
  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),
]) {
```

With explicit types, an image-only clipboard fails both backends and keeps the correct named `'xclip/wl-paste unavailable or clipboard holds no text'` reason instead of pasting binary garbage.

# pr-1580: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard

## Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

      # Issue #1234: the ≤2800-line file guard MOVED into crap4dart's loc
      # gate (crap4dart.yaml, wc -l parity verified by the maintainer
      # recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Windows text read is not UTF-8 — non-ASCII clipboard text mojibakes**

`Get-Clipboard` runs under `powershell` (Windows PowerShell 5.1), whose redirected stdout is written in the OEM code page (e.g. cp437/cp850), **not** UTF-8. The output is then decoded as UTF-8 here with `allowMalformed: true`, so any non-ASCII clipboard text ("café", "Привет", CJK) silently degrades to U+FFFD replacement characters — exactly the lossy path this repo's image readers deliberately avoid: the pre-existing `_readWindows` image path never reads stdout (it writes a file and reads the bytes back, see `_readWindows` below in this file).

Secondary: `Get-Clipboard` formats each line with `\r\n`, so multi-line text keeps embedded `\r` after the single trailing-newline strip; the composer inserts verbatim (no `\r` normalization exists in the TUI paste path).

**Suggested fix** (mirror the image path's stdout avoidance, or pin the encoding):

```dart
final read = _textFromStdout(
  await runner('powershell', [
    '-NoProfile',
    '-Command',
    '[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard',
  ]),
);
```

- `xclip -selection clipboard -o` defaults to `STRING`; on a clipboard that holds only image flavors it errors out (fine).
- `wl-paste --no-newline` **without `--type` pastes the first MIME type offered by the source** — for an image-only clipboard that is `image/png`/`image/jpeg`, exit code 0, stdout = raw image bytes.

Trigger path: clipboard holds only a non-PNG image (e.g. JPEG-only — the image reader only probes `image/png`), so `readPasteboardImage` misses → the Ctrl+V fallback runs → `wl-paste --no-newline` happily returns the image bytes → `_textFromStdout` decodes them with `allowMalformed: true` → a wall of mojibake `PasteboardText` is inserted into the composer (and one keypress away from being submitted).

**Suggested fix** — pin text types the way the image path does:

```dart
for (final (executable, args) in [
  ('xclip', ['-selection', 'clipboard', '-t', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '-o']),
  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),
]) {

With explicit types, an image-only clipboard fails both backends and keeps the correct named `'xclip/wl-paste unavailable or clipboard holds no text'` reason instead of pasting binary garbage.

# pr-1580: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard

## Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.

# pr-1580: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard

## Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"

# pr-1580: gh-1575 [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard

## Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

      # Issue #1234: the ≤2800-line file guard MOVED into crap4dart's loc
      # gate (crap4dart.yaml, wc -l parity verified by the maintainer
      # recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +

      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"

      # Issue #1234: the ≤2800-line file guard MOVED into crap4dart's loc
      # gate (crap4dart.yaml, wc -l parity verified by the maintainer
      # recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +

      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"

      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"

{"content":"# Rework — PR #1580 (gh-1575): every open review thread resolved and re-verified

## Issues/Notes

- The open review thread (Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES) carried 1 blocking, 2 important and 2 suggestion findings. All are addressed on the rework head (`13e4dde`), the same head CI validated green (no failed checks per the CI snapshot at rework start).
- This pass re-verified each fix against the CI-pinned toolchain (`crap4dart 0.11.0`, Dart SDK 3.13.5) instead of taking the fixes on faith; no further production change was required — the residual work was verification and thread closure.
- The working tree carries unrelated staged WIP from a parallel effort (gh-1510 files: `agent_cli.dart`, `ansi_markdown.dart`, `memory_controller.dart`, goldens, `memory_print_redirect_test.dart`). It belongs to another task, was left untouched, and is not part of this PR's change set (PR diff = the 11 gh-1575 files below, `git diff origin/main...HEAD`).

## Approach

1. **🚨 BLOCKING — loc gate (`fa_tui.dart` 2807 > 2800).** `FaTuiCallbacks` moved verbatim into the new part file `lib/src/cli/fa_tui_callbacks.dart` (`part of 'fa_tui.dart'` — same library, importers see no change; same precedent as `fa_tui_paste.dart`). Re-verified:
   - `fa_tui.dart` = **2694 lines** (gate 2800; was 2807); whole-tree `wc -l` scan: nothing over 2800 in `lib`/`bin`/`test`/`example`
   - `crap4dart check --baseline` (pinned `crap4dart 0.11.0`) → exit 0, `Gates: 3 passed, 1 warned, 21 skipped` (the warn is the pre-existing soft duplication `[WARN]`)
   - `crap4dart.yaml` `max_lines` untouched ("only down")
2. **⚠️ Windows text read.** `Get-Clipboard` now pins UTF-8 console output on the same command line — `'[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard'` — so non-ASCII text no longer degrades to U+FFFD via the PowerShell 5.1 OEM code page; after the single formatter trailing-newline strip, every embedded `\r\n` is normalized to `\n` (`replaceAll`).
3. **⚠️ Linux text read.** Both backends are type-pinned the way the image path pins `image/png`: `xclip … -t text/plain;charset=utf-8`, `wl-paste --type text/plain;charset=utf-8`. An image-only clipboard (e.g. JPEG-only) now fails both backends and keeps the named `xclip/wl-paste unavailable or clipboard holds no text` reason instead of dumping decoded image bytes into the composer.
4. **💡 Suggestions.** The library header no longer claims `FA_FAKE_PASTEBOARD` "short-circuits everything" — it documents that the seam short-circuits the **image** read only and the text read has no fake seam (script it via the injected `ProcessRunner`). `test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart` is `dart format`-clean under SDK 3.13.5; the drift left in `clipboard_reader.dart`/`fa_tui_stub.dart`/`fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart` is pre-existing on `main` (verified against `main`'s copies) and untouched per the review note.

- `lib/src/cli/fa_tui_callbacks.dart` — new part file holding `FaTuiCallbacks` (blocking loc-gate fix)
- `lib/src/cli/fa_tui.dart` — `part 'fa_tui_callbacks.dart'`; callback block relocated (2807 → 2694 lines)
- `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` — TIFF probe + `sips` PNG conversion, `readPasteboardText` (UTF-8-pinned Windows command, type-pinned Linux backends, CRLF normalization), doc fix
- `lib/src/cli/paste_image.dart` — `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family
- `lib/src/cli/fa_tui_paste.dart` — Ctrl+V image→text fallback wrap
- `lib/src/cli/fa_tui_stub.dart` / `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader_stub.dart` — `readClipboardText` wiring + web stub
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_repl_boot.dart` — real text-reader wiring
- `test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart` / `test/cli/fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart` — review regression tests
- `CHANGELOG.md` — gh-1575 entry incl. the review-pass notes

  - `the Windows text command pins UTF-8 on the console encoding`
  - `the Windows text path normalizes embedded CRLF to LF`
  - `the Linux text backends pin the text content type`

- `dart analyze` on all changed files → clean (one `unnecessary_import` info in `fa_tui.dart` pre-exists on `main`)

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"

      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done

          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.

{"content":"# Rework — PR #1580 (gh-1575): every open review thread resolved and re-verified

## Issues/Notes

- The open review thread (Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES) carried 1 blocking, 2 important and 2 suggestion findings. All are addressed on the rework head (`13e4dde`), the same head CI validated green (no failed checks per the CI snapshot at rework start).
- This pass re-verified each fix against the CI-pinned toolchain (`crap4dart 0.11.0`, Dart SDK 3.13.5) instead of taking the fixes on faith; no further production change was required — the residual work was verification and thread closure.
- The working tree carries unrelated staged WIP from a parallel effort (gh-1510 files: `agent_cli.dart`, `ansi_markdown.dart`, `memory_controller.dart`, goldens, `memory_print_redirect_test.dart`). It belongs to another task, was left untouched, and is not part of this PR's change set (PR diff = the 11 gh-1575 files below, `git diff origin/main...HEAD`).

## Approach

1. **🚨 BLOCKING — loc gate (`fa_tui.dart` 2807 > 2800).** `FaTuiCallbacks` moved verbatim into the new part file `lib/src/cli/fa_tui_callbacks.dart` (`part of 'fa_tui.dart'` — same library, importers see no change; same precedent as `fa_tui_paste.dart`). Re-verified:
   - `fa_tui.dart` = **2694 lines** (gate 2800; was 2807); whole-tree `wc -l` scan: nothing over 2800 in `lib`/`bin`/`test`/`example`
   - `crap4dart check --baseline` (pinned `crap4dart 0.11.0`) → exit 0, `Gates: 3 passed, 1 warned, 21 skipped` (the warn is the pre-existing soft duplication `[WARN]`)
   - `crap4dart.yaml` `max_lines` untouched ("only down")
2. **⚠️ Windows text read.** `Get-Clipboard` now pins UTF-8 console output on the same command line — `'[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard'` — so non-ASCII text no longer degrades to U+FFFD via the PowerShell 5.1 OEM code page; after the single formatter trailing-newline strip, every embedded `\r\n` is normalized to `\n` (`replaceAll`).
3. **⚠️ Linux text read.** Both backends are type-pinned the way the image path pins `image/png`: `xclip … -t text/plain;charset=utf-8`, `wl-paste --type text/plain;charset=utf-8`. An image-only clipboard (e.g. JPEG-only) now fails both backends and keeps the named `xclip/wl-paste unavailable or clipboard holds no text` reason instead of dumping decoded image bytes into the composer.
4. **💡 Suggestions.** The library header no longer claims `FA_FAKE_PASTEBOARD` "short-circuits everything" — it documents that the seam short-circuits the **image** read only and the text read has no fake seam (script it via the injected `ProcessRunner`). `test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart` is `dart format`-clean under SDK 3.13.5; the drift left in `clipboard_reader.dart`/`fa_tui_stub.dart`/`fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart` is pre-existing on `main` (verified against `main`'s copies) and untouched per the review note.

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/cli/fa_tui_callbacks.dart` — new part file holding `FaTuiCallbacks` (blocking loc-gate fix)
- `lib/src/cli/fa_tui.dart` — `part 'fa_tui_callbacks.dart'`; callback block relocated (2807 → 2694 lines)
- `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` — TIFF probe + `sips` PNG conversion, `readPasteboardText` (UTF-8-pinned Windows command, type-pinned Linux backends, CRLF normalization), doc fix
- `lib/src/cli/paste_image.dart` — `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family
- `lib/src/cli/fa_tui_paste.dart` — Ctrl+V image→text fallback wrap
- `lib/src/cli/fa_tui_stub.dart` / `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader_stub.dart` — `readClipboardText` wiring + web stub
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_repl_boot.dart` — real text-reader wiring
- `test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart` / `test/cli/fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart` — review regression tests
- `CHANGELOG.md` — gh-1575 entry incl. the review-pass notes

## Test Coverage

- Each review finding is pinned by a regression test:
  - `the Windows text command pins UTF-8 on the console encoding`
  - `the Windows text path normalizes embedded CRLF to LF`
  - `the Linux text backends pin the text content type`
  - `an image-only Linux clipboard is not dumped into the composer`
  - plus the gh-1575 flow tests (TIFF→sips, failed-conversion fall-through, Ctrl+V text insert / image preference / both-miss / no-text-reader legacy path)
- Targeted run: `dart test test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart` → **40/40 passed**
- `dart analyze` on all changed files → clean (one `unnecessary_import` info in `fa_tui.dart` pre-exists on `main`)
- Full suite: 10564 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"

      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"

uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get

      # Issue #1234: the ≤2800-line file guard MOVED into crap4dart's loc
      # gate (crap4dart.yaml, wc -l parity verified by the maintainer
      # recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
